div.span: EXTERNAL STAGE BLUEPRINT (zero framework code):1. Read Phase[N-1] JSON from stdin or --in-file; validate with the published Pydantic model (strict, extra=forbid). 2. Compute. Log only to stderr. 3. Write Phase[N] JSON to --out-file and the same bytes to stdout. 4. Exit 0; non-zero on any failure. Then: rag-pN-1 | my-stage | rag-pN+1.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;
div.span: IN-PHASE STRATEGY BLUEPRINT:1. def my_strategy(section, max_words, overlap) -> list[DocumentChunk] 2. CHUNKERS['my_strategy'] = my_strategy (or entry point in group rag.chunkers once it lands) 3. rag-p04 -s my_strategy ; output.chunk_strategy == 'my_strategy'

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;
div.span: ENGINE BACKEND BLUEPRINT (seams 3a, 3b, 4):1. Write the loader or scorer in hybrid_engine.py; fetch weights through prefetch_st / prefetch_fastembed / ensure_model. 2. Register one line: DENSE_BACKENDS['my_backend'] = loader (SPARSE_BACKENDS / RERANK_BACKENDS likewise). 3. rag-p05 -b my_backend -m org/model ; the choice travels in Phase05 and Phase06 so P07 encodes queries the same way.
